entry.name: multislider
entry.digest: Display data as sliders or a scrolling display
entry.description: Displays data as either an array of sliders or a scrolling display. When configured as sliders, the values are set (and output) as numeric lists. When configured as a scrolling display, multislider receives numbers, plots them, and scrolls the display area.

attributes.name: candycane
attributes.description: Enables theobject to use multiple colors for adjacent sliders, with the color pattern repeating (like the stripes in a candycane) every N sliders (indicated by the integer argument). The first eight colors can be set with theand-messages, the next fifteen colors are taken from the Max application's color palette. The number of stripes in the candycane can also be set using the Inspector.

attributes.name: compatibility
attributes.description: Toggles the backwards-compatibility mode for the,andmessages. If this mode is enabled, theobject will output the single-value results of these messages out the left outlet, otherwise the values will be output out the right (single slider value) outlet, just like themessage. Patches saved before Max 4.6 will automatically open with compatibility mode enabled.

attributes.name: contdata
attributes.description: Sets the mouse output mode for non-scrolling display styles. If this mode is set to(, theobject will output a list of its current slider values each time the mouse is clicked and dragged. If this mode is set to(, theobject will output a list when the mouse button is pressed and again when it is released. When set to(), theobject will only output a list when the mouse button is released. The mouse output mode can also be set using the Inspector.

attributes.description: When followed by a percentage value from 1 to 100, enables the drawing of a "ghost" bar when mode theobject is in Thin Line mode. A percentage value of 1 will draw a very light bar behind the Thin Line line, a value of 50 will draw a half-dark bar, and a value of 100 will draw a bar the same color as the Thin Line slider. When the wordis followed by a zero, this drawing mode is disabled (which it is by default).

The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

attributes.description: Sets the low and high range values for theobject. The default values are -1.0 and 1.0 for floating point sliders and 0 and 127 for integer sliders.

attributes.name: setstyle
attributes.description: Sets the display style of theobject. The default value is Thin Line ().

attributes.name: settype
attributes.description: Sets theobject for integer (0) or floating point (1) operation. The Inspector can also be used to set theobject's type. The default is integer ().

attributes.name: shadowalpha
attributes.description: Theattribute sets the opacity of the gradient shadow used to draw bars. At 0 (the default), the gradient is invisible; at 1 it is completely opaque.must be non-zero for the other shadow drawing attributes to have an effect on the object's appearance.

attributes.name: shadowblend
attributes.description: Sets the amount of black blended with the object'sto create the shadow. Values ofcloser to 0 will be darker; values closer to 1 will be lighter.

attributes.name: shadowproportion
attributes.description: Sets the vertical mid point within the shadow gradient. 0 is at the bottom, 1 is at the top.

attributes.name: signed
attributes.description: Sets the signed or unsigned display mode for bar sliders. The default is 0 (off), and bar sliders are drawn from the minimum value. When this mode is set to 1 (on) sliders are drawn from zero to either a positive or negative slider value.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the number of sliders theobject has. The default is 1, and the maximum number of sliders is 4096.

attributes.name: slidercolor
attributes.description: Specifies the slider color of theobject. The default value is black ().

attributes.name: spacing
attributes.description: Sets the amount of space (in pixels) between sliders. The default is 0 (all sliders touching one another).

messages.name: anything
messages.digest: Function depends on compatibility mode
messages.description: is used to offer backwards compatibility in conjunction with themessage.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Output the current slider values as a list
messages.description: Outputs the current slider values as a list.

messages.name: copy
messages.digest: Copyvalues
messages.description: Themessage copies the values of a multislider, including the,, andattributes.

messages.name: drawbars
messages.digest: Display slider values as bars
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a non-zero number will set theto draw bars when displaying slider values. When followed by a 0, the sliders' values will not be drawn in bars.

messages.name: drawlines
messages.digest: Display slider values as lines
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a non-zero number will set theto draw lines when displaying slider values. When followed by a 0, the sliders' values will not be drawn in lines.

messages.name: echo
messages.digest: Enable echoing input lists to output
messages.description: Toggles echo mode on and off. When echo mode is on, theobject will output any list received in its inlet. The default is on (1).

messages.name: fetch
messages.digest: Fetch and output the value of a slider
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sends the value of the numbered slider out the right (single slider value) outlet. Slider numbering starts at 1. Any number less than 1 will report the first slider's value.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Set all slider values and output a list
messages.description: Sets all slider values and positions to the number received and outputs a list reflecting the current values. If thedata type is set to int, the values in the incoming list are truncated and converted to ints.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Set all slider values and output a list
messages.description: Sets all slider values and positions to the number received and outputs a list reflecting the current values. If thedata type is set to float, the values in the incoming list are converted to floats.

messages.name: interp
messages.digest: Enable interpolated output values
messages.description: Sending the word, followed by a one or zero, enables or disables interpolation mode. When interpolation mode is on (the default), theobject will output interpolated values when a slider is moved. In most cases you probably will not want to disable interpolation mode.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Set slider values
messages.description: Sets each slider to a corresponding value in the list from left to right, with the first value in the list setting the first slider. If thehas a different number of sliders than is present in the list, the number of sliders is changed to the number of items in the list. In such a case, the outside dimensions of thewill not change, only the width or height of the sliders.

messages.name: max
messages.digest: Set all sliders to maximum values
messages.description: Sets all sliders to their maximum values.

messages.name: maximum
messages.digest: Output the largest slider value
messages.description: The wordcauses the value of the slider with the largest value to be sent out the right outlet.

messages.name: min
messages.digest: Set all sliders to minimum values
messages.description: Sets all sliders to their minimum values.

messages.name: minimum
messages.digest: Output the smallest slider value
messages.description: The wordcauses the value of the slider with the smallest value to be sent out the right outlet.

messages.name: normalize
messages.digest: Rescale slider values relative to a given value
messages.description: The word, followed by a float, will scale the sample values in theso that the highest number matches the value given by the argument. Every value is scaled, and this activity cannot be undone. Although themessage calculates a normalized list based on the value passed as its argument, the message does not update the values in theobject itself or display them.

messages.name: paste
messages.digest: Pastevalues if,, andare the same
messages.description: Themessage pastesvalues that were previously copied if the,, andattributes are the same. Pasting will fail if thethat you paste into does not have the same,, andattributes.

messages.name: pastereplace
messages.digest: Pastevalues and replace,, and
messages.description: Themessage pastesvalues that were previously copied and sets the,, andattributes so that they are the same as what was copied.

messages.name: peakreset
messages.digest: Reset peak values to current slider values

messages.name: quantiles
messages.digest: Output the quantile for an input list
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a list of floats between 0 and 1.0, multiplies each list element by the sum of all the values in the. This result is then divided by 215 (32,768). Then,sends out the address at which the sum of all values up to that address is greater than or equal to the result for each list element.

messages.name: range
messages.digest: Set the range for all sliders
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a minimum number and a maximum number will set all sliders to operate within that range.

messages.name: scrollclear
messages.digest: Clear theobject in scrolling mode.

messages.name: select
messages.digest: Set selected slider values
messages.description: Selectively sets slider values. For example,sets the first slider to 30, the second to 4, and the fifth slider to 50 (the top or leftmost slider is always number 1).

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set a slider value with no output
messages.description: The word, followed by a slider number and a value, sets the numbered slider to that value without triggering any output.

messages.name: setlist
messages.digest: Set slider values from a list with no output
messages.description: The word, followed by a list of slider values, sets the sliders to the listed values without triggering any output.

messages.name: setmax
messages.digest: Set the maximum value for all sliders
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the high values for theobject.

messages.name: setmin
messages.digest: Set the maximum value for all sliders
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the low values for theobject.

messages.name: sum
messages.digest: Outputs a sum of all slider values as a float
messages.description: Outputs a sum of all current slider values as a float.
